name: Dynamics of Mechanical Systems
description: Introduction to mechanical systems and their dynamical behavior. Review of kinematics of particles and rigid bodies. Review of Newton-Euler mechanics: linear and angular momentum, kinetic energy, and balance laws. Degrees of freedom, generalized coordinates, holonomic and nonholonomic constraints. Principle of virtual work, workless constraints, and Lagrange multipliers. Equilibria and stability of conservative systems. D’Alembert’s principle and Lagrange’s equations. Free and forced vibrations of single degree of freedom systems: undamped and damped. Vibration of two degree of freedom systems (free-undamped only): natural frequency and mode shape. Phase portraits and stability analysis of dynamical systems.
